post.summary: Save role permissions and menu selection
post.description: Requires a user-verified access token and acl_role:create or acl_role:update. Menu selections narrow navigation and do not grant page or API privileges. Menu selections combine across roles, with ancestor containers included automatically. A role with no selected menus contributes no navigation. Role fields and menu mappings are saved in one transaction.

menuIds.description: Full selection of menu entry IDs. An empty list clears the selection; omitting this field retains it. Replaced atomically with the role fields.

400.description: Invalid role fields or menu IDs.

403.description: Missing role write privileges or user verification.
